# Incoming images — drop-in checklist

Save the new photography with these exact filenames, drop the files into this
folder (`adl-consultancy/assets/img/`), then run `python3 build.py` from
`adl-consultancy/`. Nothing else to edit — the pages already reference these
names, or will once the slot is switched on.

The build **fails loudly** if a referenced file is missing, so a half-finished
drop can't ship silently.

---

## 5. Accreditation & client logos

Transparent PNG please, not JPEG — these sit on white and on the dark footer.

| Save as | What | Status |
|---|---|---|
| `logo-lrqa-registered-012.png` | LRQA 012 Registered Consultant | new, better than the one in the build |
| `logo-auva-arc.png` | Auva ARC Registered Consultant | have a version, yours is cleaner |
| `logo-mce-railway-safety.png` | MCE Railway Safety | **new — client, not accreditation** |

`logo-mce-railway-safety.png` doesn't belong in the footer badge strip, which is
accreditation bodies only. It needs a client-logo section, which the site does
not currently have. Worth building one — but it needs more than one logo to look
deliberate, so send whichever other client marks ADL has permission to display.
